title: Quest live coupled R1-A5 whole-upper-body simulation pilot
comparability: Incompatible with schema-2 independent-arm T007 runs: waist_yaw participates in both wrist and head tasks and wrist orientation is now a weighted task. Also incompatible with schema-3 runs made before 2026-08-18: unreachable targets are now projected and dispatched instead of freezing all controlled joints, and waist_roll may be controlled.

whole_upper_body.rate_limit_source: Carried from the schema-2 T007 offline replay; simulation-only tuning, not a hardware safety limit.
whole_upper_body.body_mode_note: Which torso joints the solver owns. 'arms_head' freezes the torso and drives both arms + head only (12-vector nominal); 'waist_yaw' is the hardware-common R1-A5 set (13-vector); 'full_upper_body' adds waist_roll as a declared simulation-only deviation (14-vector) that is NOT hardware-comparable and whose pitch/yaw-only head task cannot represent a rolled head. nominal_joint_position_rad and fixed_joints must match the selected mode. The runner's --body-mode overrides this and is recorded in the resolved config.
whole_upper_body.seed_restart_note: Re-solve once from the declared nominal when a continuation solve stalls above this residual AND both targets are inside the arms' conservative reach bound. Source: offline replay of t007_whole_upper_body_20260818T114338Z, where bringing the hands in to the body trapped the solver in a folded-posture local minimum the continuation seed could not cross. Mean position residual for targets within 0.32 m of the shoulder fell from 0.3815 m to 0.0010 m (max 0.5943 -> 0.0025 m), and the reach gate kept mean solve cost at 149.6 ms versus 156.8 ms unchanged. Iterations, step size, damping and task weights had no effect on this failure; only the seed did. Simulation-only tuning, not a hardware limit.
whole_upper_body.projection_policy: A wrist target outside the bounded joint workspace has no exact root. The solver returns the closest reachable iterate (status projected_to_reachable_boundary, or iteration_budget_exhausted when it was still improving at the cap) and this profile dispatches it, recording solver_solution_kind=projected with its residual. Before 2026-08-18 such a target froze all controlled joints, which is why large extensions stopped tracking. singular_system and other genuine solver failures are still refused and still hold.
whole_upper_body.wrist_orientation_policy: Weighted best fit is recorded but does not gate acceptance: each physical arm has five joints and cannot realize an arbitrary independent 6-DoF wrist pose. The pi tolerance makes that policy explicit in schema 3.
whole_upper_body.numerical_pilot_note: The 40-iteration cap is a simulation pilot setting. Offline replay of the 26 enabled synthetic targets from the pre-revision T000000Z smoke converged all targets in at most 11 iterations and averaged 14.0 ms/target on this workstation after task-only convergence was adopted; this is not Quest timing evidence.
whole_upper_body.sim_online_note: Ngan sach lap chon theo chi phi THUAN bo giai, do ngoai Isaac. Trong Isaac moi buoc ton 37.1 ms nhung CHI 6.3 ms la bo giai; 30.8 ms con lai la PhysX + render, khong ton tai tren phan cung. Tran nhip do bo giai la 159 Hz o 20 vong, khong phai 27 Hz do duoc trong Isaac. Vi vay viec ha max_iterations tu 40 xuong 20 truoc do la danh doi chat luong khong can thiet. So hoi tu KHONG doi theo ngan sach lap (221/400 o ca 20/40/60/100) vi phan khong hoi tu la bay gioi han khop, nhung nghiem projected van tot len: p95 124 mm o 20 vong xuong 87 mm o 100 vong, voi 26.8 ms van duoi ngan sach 33.3 ms.

invalid_if: required evidence or the resolved configuration is missing
the controlled joint order differs from the declared 12-joint arms_head order
waist_yaw or waist_roll moves while hold_uncontrolled_waist_joints is true
scientific_failure_if: a reachable position/head target is refused
a projected (non-exact) target is reported as exact tracking
the achieved control rate or tracking residual does not meet a separately declared acceptance criterion
